# Anita International Freight (Anita 国际物流)

> Shenzhen-based individual freight forwarder specializing in DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) door-to-door shipping from China to the US, UK, Europe, and Canada. Personal service via WeChat (anitaleung8888) — 8+ years in the trade, own warehouse in Bao'an Shenzhen, own customs channels.

Anita International Freight is operated by Anita Leung (梁丽塔), serving overseas Chinese, international students, FBA sellers, and cross-border e-commerce. Every quote and message is handled personally — no call center. The service ships frozen food, alcohol, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, branded goods, furniture, and general cargo with all duties prepaid (DDP).

## Core service modes

- [Sea freight (海运)](https://www.anitalogistics.com/#transport): FCL 20'/40'/40HQ at bottom-deck rates, LCL with flexible dispatch. 25–45 days door-to-door.
- [Sea + Truck (海卡)](https://www.anitalogistics.com/#transport): Sea to port + last-mile truck delivery. Best for furniture and bulk e-commerce.
- [Air freight (空运)](https://www.anitalogistics.com/#transport): Own air capacity, 12 KG minimum. 7–12 days door-to-door.
- [Air + Truck (空卡)](https://www.anitalogistics.com/#transport): Air express + destination trucking. Top choice for student luggage and mid-size e-commerce.

## Routes (起运地: Shenzhen)

- [United States](https://www.anitalogistics.com/#routes): LA, NY, Chicago, Houston + full coverage. Sea 25–30 days, Air 7–12 days.
- [United Kingdom](https://www.anitalogistics.com/#routes): England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland. Sea 30–35 days, Air 7–12 days.
- [Europe](https://www.anitalogistics.com/#routes): DE, FR, NL, BE, IT, ES, Nordics, Russia line. Sea 35–45 days, Air 7–12 days.
- [Canada](https://www.anitalogistics.com/#routes): Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Calgary, Ottawa + remote provinces. Sea 25–30 days, Air 7–11 days.
